instruction:
Fix `packages/element/src/Scene.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Circular-import bug: Scene.ts imports DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and isElementOnPage from the "@excalidraw/element" barrel (lines ~24-29) and uses DEFAULT_PAGE_ID in the class field initializer `private activePageId: string | null = DEFAULT_PAGE_ID;`. When a module that imports Scene loads before the barrel finishes (packages/element/src/__tests__/transform.test.ts, packages/element/tests/dragElements.test.ts, renderOverrides.test.tsx, binding.test.tsx, delta.test.tsx), DEFAULT_PAGE_ID is still undefined, so activePageId is undefined, recomputeActivePageCaches filters out EVERY element (getNonDeletedElements() = [], getNonDeletedElementsMap() empty) and bound text/containers are never found: 18 transform tests fail (label x 261 -> 255, heights), dragElements 'expected [] to have a length of 3', renderOverrides 'expected [] to include {rect}', binding.test 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "text")', delta.test 'expected 10 to be greater than 10', and history bound-text tests ('should redraw remotely added bound text when its container is updated through the history' keeps text 100x100 at 0,0). Fix: import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, isElementOnPage and getElementPageId directly from "./pages" (not the barrel), and make the page filter robust: treat an undefined/null activePageId as DEFAULT_PAGE_ID (`const pageId = this.activePageId ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_ID`) inside recomputeActivePageCaches. Keep `null` meaning 'all pages' only if it is passed explicitly via setActivePageId(null). Do not change any other behaviour.
